dialogues.speaker: Read
dialogues.text: Some notes are scattered on the table...

response.speaker: Travel Plans
response.text: "I've heard there's a new clothing trend in Natlan. Will check it out when I have some time..."

response.speaker: Travel Plans
response.text: "Snezhnayan designs can be used as reference for winter wear... if it's on the way..."

response.speaker: Letter to Chevreuse
response.text: "Maison Gardiennage... employee... speaking in the store of a deal between their superior and... tone was conclusive..."

response.speaker: Letter to Chevreuse
response.text: "Someone... witnessed a wanted criminal... coming and going. I fear that is just a rumor..."

response.speaker: Letter to Charlotte
response.text: "...Thanks for your recent report. Here are the new decorations for Monsieur Verite."

response.speaker: Letter to Charlotte
response.text: "...Let's have some tea when you get the chance. Tea only, by the way. No interviews."
